id: title:jurajmajerik:add delete action to the shared metric form

review.posthog_relevance: Reduces code duplication and potential inconsistency in the SharedMetric scene's dialog handling, improving maintainability of the frontend shared metrics feature.
review.reason: The change extracts shared dialog and delete action handlers into a utility function, removing repeated inline implementations. This is a localized frontend maintenance improvement.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is limited to code maintainability and does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction or critical path changes; no backend or shared dependency changes are observed.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single-file frontend change. No tier assignment is made; score is withheld. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a shared utility function openDeleteSharedMetricDialog and its import, removing repeated inline dialog definitions.
observations.posthog_connection: SharedMetric scene now uses a shared dialog helper rather than repeating the same LemonDialog.open configuration, reducing duplication and potential inconsistency.

observations.behavior: Replaces an inline onClick handler with a call to openDeleteSharedMetricDialog, passing the deleteSharedMetric callback.
observations.posthog_connection: SharedMetric scene now delegates the delete action to the shared helper, removing the repeated dialog implementation and its associated onClick closure.
